name: OAKA Residences
address: Jalan Jalil Perkasa 7, Bukit Jalil, 57100 Kuala Lumpur
nearby: Bukit Jalil Golf & Country Resort, 1.8 km
Sri Petaling and Awan Besar LRT stations
about: Two 30-storey towers of 175 units each on 2.2 acres of freehold land in Bukit Jalil, facing the Bukit Jalil Golf & Country Resort. With 350 units at 7 per floor, every layout has a storage room and 2 to 3 car parks, and units are handed over partially furnished. GreenRE Gold certified and pet-friendly, with an infinity pool, a 3,084 sq ft gym and a sky garden.
highlights: Freehold, 350 units at only 7 per floor
2 to 3 car parks for every unit
Infinity pool, 3,084 sq ft gym and rooftop sky garden
Foreigners can buy units priced above RM 1M

review.verdict: A freehold, low-density family condo facing the Bukit Jalil golf course, with generous parking and partial furnishing.
good: Freehold, with only 7 units per floor across 2 towers
2 to 3 car parks for every unit, and every layout has a storage room
Handed over partially furnished
Walking distance to IMU and Columbia Asia Hospital, about 1 km away
watch: About RM 820 to 950 per sq ft, depending on the tower
Maintenance fee of about RM 0.51 per sq ft, higher than most projects here
No LRT within walking distance; Sri Petaling and Awan Besar need a short drive
Extra car parks can't be bought
review.suits: Families buying to live in who want freehold, space for 2 to 3 cars and golf-course views in Bukit Jalil.
review.notFor: Buyers with a budget under RM 800k.

name: The Vividz
address: Jalan Bukit Jalil Indah 2, Bukit Jalil, 57000 Kuala Lumpur
about: Compact serviced apartments in Bukit Jalil, one of the lowest entry prices in the area.

review.verdict: The cheapest way into Bukit Jalil on this site, built for small households and rental.
good: SPA price from under RM 450k, the lowest quantum here
Compact one- and two-room units are easy to rent to singles and couples
A small loan keeps the monthly instalment low
watch: Leasehold
About RM 922 per sq ft on the 484 sq ft unit; small units carry a high price per foot
Completion in 2029, a longer wait
The smallest units are tight for a family
review.suits: First-time buyers and investors who want a low entry price.
review.notFor: Families who need three full-size bedrooms.

name: ARAS Residences
developer: WCT Land (WCT OUG Development Sdn Bhd)
address: WCity OUG, Jalan Awan Besar, Taman Overseas Union, 58200 Kuala Lumpur
about: Two freehold towers of 636 serviced residences each inside the WCity OUG township, facing its central park. Layouts are 850 sq ft with 2 rooms or 1,062 sq ft with 3 rooms, and facilities include a 50 m lap pool, a feature cabana and a sky terrace.
highlights: Freehold parkfront living in WCity OUG
50 m lap pool, feature cabana and sky terrace

review.verdict: Freehold in a large park township at a fair price per square foot, with a long build ahead.
good: Freehold, facing the WCity OUG central park
About RM 784 per sq ft at the lowest SPA price
Practical 2-room and 3-room layouts, each with 2 bathrooms
50 m lap pool, feature cabana and sky terrace
watch: 1,272 units in two towers, so it is not low density
Sri Petaling LRT is about 1.6 km away, not a short walk
Completion in December 2029
Classified as serviced residences; check the title type and utility rates
review.suits: Couples and small families who want freehold under RM 1M.
review.notFor: Buyers who want to move in before 2029.

name: D'Evia Residences
address: Jalan Sungai Buloh, Kwasa Damansara, Selangor
about: Low-density serviced residence of 440 units in the Kwasa Damansara transit township, walking distance to the MRT.

review.verdict: A low-density MRT home with up to four rooms for under RM 710k.
good: Only 440 units, low density for a high-rise
Walking distance to Kwasa Damansara MRT
Four-room layouts at 1,109 sq ft for under RM 710k
watch: Leasehold, on commercial land under the HDA
One listing site rates the surrounding area as high flood risk; check the site and its drainage before booking
Completion in 2029, in a township that is still being built
review.suits: MRT commuters and young families who want space for the price.
review.notFor: Buyers who want a mature neighbourhood today.

name: LEVIA Residence
address: Jalan Lingkaran Tengah 2 (MRR2), Pandan Perdana, Cheras, 56100 Kuala Lumpur
about: Two-tower family condominium of 778 units in Pandan Perdana, Cheras, with hotel-style facilities.
highlights: Family sizes up to 1,364 sq ft

review.verdict: Large family layouts in Cheras from a well-known developer, completing first among these projects.
good: Family sizes up to 1,364 sq ft with 3+1 and 4+1 rooms
Residential title
Topped out in March 2026, with completion in 2027
Taman Kencana MRT about 900 m away
watch: 99-year leasehold
Sold well early, so unit and floor choice is limited
MRR2 traffic at peak hours
review.suits: Families upgrading to a bigger home in Cheras.
review.notFor: Investors looking for small rental units.

name: The Atas
address: Jalan Desa Utama, Taman Desa, 58100 Kuala Lumpur
about: Three 30-storey towers of 208 units each in Taman Desa, 624 units in all, designed for multi-generation families. Layouts run from 1,156 to 1,518 sq ft with 3+1 to 4+1 rooms, and every unit has 2 to 3 car parks. Facilities include a 25 m pool, tennis and half-basketball courts, a badminton hall and a sky pavilion.
highlights: 2 to 3 car parks for every unit
Air-conditioners and instant water heaters installed
Pet-friendly development with KL city views
Foreigners can buy units priced above RM 1M

review.verdict: Spacious family homes in Taman Desa, close to Mid Valley, at one of the lowest prices per square foot on this site.
good: Low density: 624 units in 3 towers, with 2 to 3 car parks per unit
Residential title, and a pet-friendly development
Air-conditioners and instant water heaters come installed
About RM 699 per sq ft at the lowest SPA price, among the lowest here
watch: Leasehold, running to 2123
No rail station within walking distance; Seputeh KTM is about 1.7 km
EV charging is limited to 10 shared bays; owners can't install their own charger for now
No hackable walls, so layouts can't be opened up
review.suits: Multi-generation families and pet owners who drive.

name: The Atera 2
about: Transit-oriented serviced residences about 400 m from Asia Jaya LRT, in a mature part of PJ.
highlights: About 400 m to Asia Jaya LRT

review.verdict: A transit home in mature PJ, a short walk from the LRT.
good: About 400 m to Asia Jaya LRT
Mature Section 14 with shops, colleges and offices around it
Wide size range, from 775 to 1,420 sq ft
watch: Leasehold, on commercial land under the HDA
About RM 892 per sq ft at the lowest SPA price
One listing site notes Section 51A as flood-prone; check the site's flood history
review.suits: Commuters into PJ and KL, and investors renting to young professionals.
review.notFor: Buyers who want a residential title.

name: Ukay Spring
address: Jalan Ukay Perdana 3, Taman Ukay Spring, Bandar Hulu Kelang, Selangor
nearby: Ampang Puteri Specialist Hospital, about 9 km
about: Gated landed homes in the 56-acre Ukay Spring masterplan in Ukay Perdana. Phase 1A and 1B have 142 homes on 21.5 acres: 116 link villas of 2.5 storeys and 26 semi-detached homes of 3 storeys, with a 6.4-acre private forest behind and a clubhouse for residents only.
highlights: Only 142 homes on 21.5 acres, gated and guarded
Private clubhouse with a 25 m pool and gym
Semi-Ds come with a home lift and 9 air-conditioners

review.verdict: Low-density landed living next to a private forest, for families who drive.
good: Only 142 homes on 21.5 acres, gated and guarded with a 3-tier security system
A 6.4-acre private forest behind Phase 1B and a residents-only clubhouse
Semi-Ds come with a lift, 9 air-conditioners and parking for 4 cars
Elevated at about 167 m above sea level
Link villas from RM 2.08M clear Selangor's RM 2M minimum for foreigners
watch: Leasehold to 2107; the developer says it will renew to 99 years from 2026, so confirm this in the SPA
About 20 km from KL city centre, so a car is essential
Hillside site; the developer reports slope approvals are in place
Resale is not allowed during construction
Link villas come without air-conditioners
review.suits: Families upgrading to landed, and MM2H buyers who want a gated home.
review.notFor: Buyers who need rail access or a short commute to the city.

name: Imperial Residences
address: Pavilion Damansara Heights, Bukit Damansara, 50490 Kuala Lumpur
nearby: Pavilion Damansara Heights MRT, 2 stops to KL Sentral
Pavilion Damansara Heights mall, over 1 million sq ft
Mont' Kiara and Garden International Schools
about: The most exclusive residential tower in Pavilion Damansara Heights: 154 freehold serviced residences from 3,380 sq ft, built over the Pavilion lifestyle mall and the Pavilion Damansara Heights MRT station, with Pavilion concierge service for residents.
highlights: Integrated with the Pavilion mall and MRT station
Every bedroom en suite, plus a private lanai

review.verdict: A freehold trophy address built over the Pavilion Damansara Heights mall and MRT station, for buyers in the RM 5 million and above bracket.
good: Freehold, with only 154 units
Mall, MRT and concierge in the same development; the MRT is 2 stops from KL Sentral
Large layouts from 3,380 sq ft with every bedroom en suite
Clears the KL minimum for foreigners and every mainland MM2H tier
watch: About RM 1,606 per sq ft at the lowest SPA price, the highest on this site
Completion in March 2030, a long wait
Classified as serviced apartments; check the title type and utility rates
An integrated mall development brings crowds and traffic around the base
review.suits: High-net-worth families, and foreign or MM2H Platinum buyers who want a central KL address.
review.notFor: Buyers looking for rental yield or a budget under RM 5 million.
